meta.rebaseline_note: v0.9.0 re-baselines the project on the PropTech AI Platform spec: multi-tenant, modular, serverless (Supabase + Netlify), WhatsApp-first, free-first LLM routing. Legacy FastAPI/Celery/Redis/scraper stack deprecated.

stack.vector: pgvector (additive matching layer, free embeddings via Ollama)
stack.llm_router: Ollama (free, default) → DeepSeek API (medium) → Claude API (heavy, admin-request only)
stack.scheduler: GitHub Actions / Cron-Job.org → secret-key-protected Edge Functions
stack.whatsapp: WhatsApp Cloud API via slim Node.js gateway (Hetzner CX11)
stack.hosting: Netlify (dashboard) + Supabase (DB + Edge Fn) + Hetzner CX11 (WhatsApp Gateway)

business_goals: Reducir drásticamente la carga de asesores, secretarias y martillero/broker

roadmap.current_node: M0 — Platform Core (LLM router + scheduler + chat summarization)
reused_foundation: Supabase Auth + RBAC base (F018) — to extend to 4 levels in M4
pgvector matching — kept as additive free search layer

pending_tomorrow: M0: implement LLM router (Ollama default → DeepSeek → Claude on admin-request)
DEUDA TD-006: remove legacy FastAPI backend + gateway/ + docker-compose celery/redis/postgres
M0: build secret-key scheduler (GitHub Actions / Cron-Job.org → Edge Fn)

ai_policy.claude_usage: Only on explicit administrator request for heavy analysis and reports. Never for routine chat, matching, or summarization.
ai_policy.matching_llm: ollama (free) — semantic + chat analysis run at zero Claude token cost
ai_policy.web_access: DISABLED — no external web search/scraping. Only fetch a consulted listing URL to verify it is a property.
